subject: Mr. Lee
text: Defeating Mr. Lee awards 21 EXP, 11 GP, and the Magic Book of Sleep.

evidence.quote:
EXP gained:         21
GP:                 11
Attacks:            Bats
Preferred Weapon:   Chain
Spoils:             Magic Book of Sleep (Slep Magic)

subject: Mr. Lee
text: The Chain flail is the preferred weapon against Mr. Lee, and his bat attacks can be blocked with the shield.

evidence.quote: Preferred Weapon:   Chain...His attacks are plain and simple. Once he stops moving, he’ll open his cape and bats will come right after you. You can block the bats with your shield though.

subject: Mr. Lee
text: To damage Mr. Lee, target his body rather than his wings.

evidence.quote: To attack him, target his body not his wings :)

subject: Julius
text: The man who helped in the Cave of Marsh is revealed to be Julius himself.

evidence.quote: The man who helped you out in the Cave of Marsh turns out to be Julius himself.

subject: Cibba
text: Cibba gives you the Magic Book of Heal in his room.

evidence.quote: Then, he’ll give you the Magic Book of Heal.

subject: General Store
text: Oil can be bought at the General Store hut for 500 GP.

evidence.quote: Here, go inside the hut. It is a General Store. Buy the Oil here for 500 GP.

subject: Mine Cart
text: Before boarding the mine cart in the Silver Mine, you must equip the Oil.

evidence.quote: Upon entrance, you’ll see a small cart to the left. First, equip the Oil that you bought a while ago.

subject: Mine Cart Switches
text: To navigate the mine cart, hold Up + Right and repeatedly press Attack when entering the screen to hit the first switch, then hold Down + Right and press Attack repeatedly to hit the second switch.

evidence.quote: Now, Press and Hold Up + Right on the Directional Pad. The cart will now go one screen to the right. As the screen, changes, press the Attack button like crazy! This will enable you to activate the switch. After successfully activating the switch, press and hold Down + Right on the directional pad. The cart will now go south one screen. Like before, just as the screen changes, press the Attack button like crazy while holding the Down+Right on the Directional Pad. This will activate another switch.

subject: Watts
text: After falling down the hole in the Silver Mine, Watts joins the party as an NPC guide.

evidence.quote: After falling down the hole, you’ll see Watts. He’ll join you as an NPC to guide you through the cave.

subject: Watts
text: Using the ASK command on Watts allows you to shop for items while in the cave.

evidence.quote: Remember that when you’re low on supplies, you can ASK Watts and he’ll let you shop for items.

subject: Recovery Spring
text: Breaking rocks south of the passage with a Mattock leads to a recovery spring.

evidence.quote: Use your Mattock to break the rocks then move on south to the next screen. Here’s you’ll see a recovery spring.

subject: Switch
text: In the room with slippery floors, break the right jar, step on the switch, and slide right toward the ladder.

evidence.quote: Here, there are 2 jars and slippery floors. Break the right jar, step on the switch and slide to the right towards the ladder leading down.

subject: Megapede
text: Defeating Megapede yields 48 EXP and 161 GP.

evidence.quote:
EXP gained:         48
GP:                 161

subject: Megapede
text: Megapede can only be damaged by hitting its head, and the Chain is the preferred weapon.

evidence.quote: Preferred Weapon:   Chain...Always remember that it can only be damaged by hitting it’s head. Any attack to the body is null.

subject: Megapede
text: Right after Megapede is defeated, quickly move away because its body scatters an explosion across a very wide area.

evidence.quote: The Magapede, due to its size, especially its length, will scatter the explosion in a very wide area so, right after you hear the explosion of the monster, quickly move away from it!

subject: Silver Mine
text: After defeating the Megapede, get the Silver from the chest.

evidence.quote: After beating the Megapede, get the Silver from the chest.

subject: Watts
text: Watts sells Armor, Shield, and Sword made from Silver in the Dwarf Cave.

evidence.quote: Talk to him. He will sell you an Armor, Shield and the Sword made from the Silver.

subject: Gaia
text: You must equip at least one piece of Silver equipment in order to enter Gaia.

evidence.quote: Remember that you MUST equip any Silver equipment in order to enter Gaia. One Silver Equipment is enough.

subject: Door Switch
text: In Gaia, stepping south closes the door, but moving north slowly touches the invisible switch again to reopen it.

evidence.quote: As you go south, you’ll step on an invisible switch that closes the south door. Here’s what you must do. Go south to the door. It will be closed right? Now, go north slowly and you’ll be able to touch the switch once again which opens the door. Once the door is open, head south one screen.

subject: Bogard
text: Upon exiting Gaia, Bogard joins the party as an NPC.

evidence.quote: Upon leaving Gaia, Bogard will come in and joins you as a NPC.

subject: General Store
text: A General Store across the bridge sells the Silver Helmet.

evidence.quote: This is a general store. You can buy the Silver Helmet here.

subject: Pole
text: Crossing the gap to reach the Airship requires latching onto the pole across the gap using a Maxed Chain with a full Will Bar.

evidence.quote: Now, equip your Chain. Go to the edge and wait for the Will Bar to fill up. If it’s full, use it on the pole on the other side. Note that you can only reach it with a Maxed Chain.
